category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be participating in a post-story Q&A team game in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our post-story Q&A game. Please sit with your team and look at the first question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the tutor and plays with a pencil) I don't care about the story. I hate English.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to focus on the game with your teammates.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts tearing strips of paper instead of looking at the questions) No.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put the paper down and answer the question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets up and starts running around the room, trying to fight with another student) I'm not doing this!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our post-story Q&A game. Please sit with your team and look at the first question.

STUDENT: (Ignores the tutor and plays with a pencil) I don't care about the story. I hate English.

TUTOR: Try to focus on the game with your teammates.

STUDENT: (Starts tearing strips of paper instead of looking at the questions) No.

TUTOR: Please put the paper down and answer the question.

STUDENT: (Gets up and starts running around the room, trying to fight with another student) I'm not doing this!

task.content: Activities related to the story with children, using songs, games (puzzles, Q & A, TPR, etc.), drawing (hand crafted books), story chain (short sentences, key words), and role play (reader theatre)

context.materials: Games (puzzles, Q & A, TPR), drawing materials, story chain materials, role play materials

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Initially when introduced to storytelling sessions
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Initially showed no interest in storytelling

behavior_patterns.condition: When disengaged from the primary task
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Played whatever they had brought with them, even a pencil, or strips of papers
